summary: Completed Module 04 Step 1 CONTEXT: established public vs tenant-authenticated boundaries, evaluating anonymous phishing abuse on creation endpoints and IDOR data leakage on resource lookups.
evidence: Identified unauthenticated surface: GET /r/:code for low-latency public redirects and GET /health for container orchestrator probes.
Formulated protection policy for tenant endpoints: securing POST /links against anonymous spam/phishing abuse and securing GET /links/:id against IDOR enumeration attacks.
